crossRefs.note: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at…
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
“He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you…
“Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick…
You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

translations.web: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
translations.bsb: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but do not do what I say?
translations.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
translations.asv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
